errors.evidence: The x-axis on the chart shows data for the years 2004 to 2019, not 2016.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с "млрд. EUR"
errors.evidence: The y-axis in the image is not labeled with any units; it only has numerical values. The unit "млрд. EUR" comes from the figure caption, but is incorrectly described as being a label on the axis.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от стойност около -7 при x = 2004
errors.evidence: The line starts at a value of approximately -3.7 in 2004, not -7.

errors.text_span: достига минимум от около -9 при x = 2005
errors.evidence: The minimum value is nearly -10 and occurs in 2008, not -9 in 2005. In 2005, the value is approximately -5.

errors.text_span: линията се покачва до около -2 при x = 2009
errors.evidence: In 2009, the value is approximately -4.8, not -2.

errors.text_span: Следва спад до около -5 при x = 2011
errors.evidence: In 2011, the line reaches a local peak of approximately -3. The description incorrectly states there is a drop to -5.
In 2013, the value is approximately -3.6, not -1.

errors.text_span: линията отново започва да спада, достигайки стойност около -3 при x = 2016
errors.evidence: In 2016, the line reaches a peak value of approximately -2.2. The description incorrectly states that it is falling and that the value is -3.
The description stops at the year 2016, but the chart contains data up to 2019. The trend from 2017 to 2019 is completely omitted.
